episodes.synopsis: Agetarou would rather go clubbing than work at his family's tonkatsu restaurant. But his tonkatsu-making skills might be the key to making him the greatest DJ of all time!
episodes.title: Episode 1

episodes.synopsis: Agetarou learns the sacred art of diggin' for records at his local shop, gathers up some equipment and hosts his first party.
episodes.title: Episode 2

episodes.synopsis: Agetarou makes a weird deal with DJ Oily to learn the secrets of the Quick Mix.
episodes.title: Episode 3

episodes.synopsis: It's time for Agetarou's first DJ session! But can he master Scratchin' and Poppin', the final secrets of the DJ's art?!
episodes.title: Episode 4

episodes.synopsis: Agetarou's first real audience is hungry for both tonkatsu and beats. Can he sail through smoothly, or will he fall prey to the DJ demons?
episodes.title: Episode 5
